landing_headline_highlight: They run on your own computers.
landing_description: Hand the work off in a message: the agent writes the code, runs the tests and opens the PR on your own machine, while you and your teammates follow along and step in whenever you want.
landing_scene_user_message: @Forge the login test is flaky again. Find the cause and open a PR.
landing_scene_agent_message: Found it: the assertion runs before the session cookie is written. Patched the test, 42 green locally. PR #118 is up for review.
landing_point_conversations_body: Say what you need in the thread. No commands to memorize, no terminal to sit and watch.
landing_point_computers_body: The work happens where your code already lives. One install connects it.
landing_point_runtimes_body: Codex, Claude Code or Pi — your choice, same conversation.
